title: Who is Rohail Rahmat
content: Rohail Rahmat is an AI engineer based in Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. He works remotely with clients in the US, Saudi Arabia, and Canada. He builds AI chatbots, AI integrations, workflow automations, RAG assistants, and micro SaaS MVPs for startups and small businesses. His GitHub is https://github.com/rohailrahmat and his LinkedIn is https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohail-rahmat.

title: Services
content: Rohail offers: 1) AI chatbot development — custom chatbots built on OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini that answer questions, qualify leads, or automate support; 2) AI integration — adding AI features to existing apps through APIs without rebuilding; 3) workflow automation using n8n and Python; 4) AI tools and micro SaaS MVPs; 5) full-stack websites and web apps with Next.js and React; 6) custom AI assistants (RAG) that answer from a client's own documents and data.

title: How Rohail works with clients
content: Rohail follows four steps: 1. Diagnose the pain point and understand the business problem deeply. 2. Break it into clear modular steps. 3. Build end to end — backend, AI integration, and interface. 4. Deploy to production and hand over with documentation. He works on a project basis and responds within 24 hours.

title: ProposalCraft AI
content: ProposalCraft AI is a tool where you paste a job post and your skills, choose a tone, and get a tailored Upwork proposal in about 10 seconds. Stack: Gemini API, Python. Live at https://proposal-craft-ai-8tkw.vercel.app/

title: Rahnuma GB
content: Rahnuma GB is an AI trip planner and RAG travel chatbot for Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. Users enter days, budget, destination, and interests, and the chatbot covers places, food, and hidden valleys based on Rohail's original research. Stack: Next.js, Node.js, Gemini API, RAG. Live at https://rahnuma-gb.vercel.app/

title: AssignmentForge
content: AssignmentForge turns assignment content into professionally formatted, submission-ready Word documents. Built for an education client in Saudi Arabia. Stack: Python, Flask. Live at https://assignment-forge-gamma.vercel.app/

title: Verdant
content: Verdant is a compliance CRM and document generator with a lead dashboard, sales pipeline, and AI SOP generator. Stack: Python, FastAPI, SQLite. Live at https://crm-compliance.vercel.app/
